extracted.name: Cucumber Gyro Sauce
extracted.description: This easy cucumber sauce mixes up in minutes with sour cream, garlic, mustard, and fresh dill. It's easy to make and tastes great so incredible on gyros!
instruction_lines: Stir sour cream, cucumber, garlic, dill, mustard, and garlic powder together in a bowl until well combined. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour before serving, or overnight for best results.
